chapters.title: Three is Company
chapters.leg: Bag End to the Woody End

waypoints.name: Bag End
waypoints.story: Frodo, Sam and Pippin slip out of Bag End after dark, round the west end of the hill and over the hedge.

waypoints.name: The lane gate
waypoints.story: A gate lets them into a lane, and they turn west, away from the lights of home.

waypoints.name: The hedgerows
waypoints.story: They leave the lane and follow the hedgerows south across the fields.

waypoints.name: Plank bridge over the Water
waypoints.story: A narrow plank bridge carries them over the Water in the dark.

waypoints.name: Crossing the East Road
waypoints.story: They cross the Great Road that runs to the Brandywine Bridge and step into the Tookland.

waypoints.name: Last sight of Hobbiton
waypoints.story: From the first slopes of the Green Hill Country Frodo turns and looks back at the lamps of Hobbiton, and says a quiet goodbye.

waypoints.name: Green Hill Country
waypoints.story: The slopes rise and fall and Hobbiton drops out of sight behind them.

waypoints.name: A frugal supper
waypoints.story: About three hours out they stop for a small supper under the stars.

waypoints.name: The Stock road
waypoints.story: They reach the road that runs east toward Stock and follow it through the night.

waypoints.name: The deep cloven track
waypoints.story: Between tall trees in a sunken track they start to sing an old walking song of Bilbo's.

waypoints.name: The steep slope
waypoints.story: A steep climb, and Pippin yawns that it must be nearly midnight.

waypoints.name: The firwood camp
waypoints.story: They sleep among the roots of a big fir just over the hill, and a passing fox stops to wonder at hobbits sleeping out of doors.

waypoints.name: The little waterfall
waypoints.story: Breakfast is late, with water fetched from a stream that tumbles over a ledge of grey stone at the foot of the hill.

waypoints.name: The rolling road
waypoints.story: Through the late morning the road rolls up and down across the Green Hill Country.

waypoints.name: Green hill fields
waypoints.story: Fields and copses slide past as they walk on in no great hurry.

waypoints.name: The steep bank
waypoints.story: The road zigzags up a steep bank, and from the top they see the Woody End and the river valley beyond. They stop for a long meal and a longer rest.

waypoints.name: The first Black Rider
waypoints.story: Hoofbeats behind them: a black-cloaked rider stops and sniffs the air while Frodo hides behind a tree, fighting a strange urge to put on the Ring.

waypoints.name: Beside the road
waypoints.story: Uneasy now, they keep a stone's throw off to the left of the road, which makes for slower going.

waypoints.name: The road to Stock
waypoints.story: The road splits and the hobbits leave it, taking a lane to the right that winds through a wood of ancient oaks.

waypoints.name: The hollow tree
waypoints.story: They creep inside a huge hollow tree to eat and rest, then walk on into the twilight singing.

waypoints.name: Gildor's Elves
waypoints.story: A rider comes sniffing again, but elven singing drives it off, and Gildor's company takes the hobbits along with them.

waypoints.name: Fold of the hills
waypoints.story: The lane runs low in a fold of the hills with hazel on the slopes, and Pippin can hardly keep his eyes open.

waypoints.name: The green ride
waypoints.story: The Elves turn off the path along a green ride through the thickets.

waypoints.name: Elven hall in the Woody End
waypoints.story: They camp on a green floor under the boughs, with the lights of Woodhall below, and Frodo talks late with Gildor.

waypoints.name: The deep-banked stream
waypoints.story: Cutting straight for the Ferry, they meet a deep stream and look back to see a Black Rider on the hill where they slept.

waypoints.name: The Stock-brook
waypoints.story: Pippin knows the stream now as the Stock-brook, and they cross where the banks are low into wet, reedy land.

waypoints.name: Belt of oaks
waypoints.story: They push into a belt of oaks, elms and ash as the first drops of rain begin to fall.

waypoints.name: Too far south
waypoints.story: Still among the trees, Pippin realises the short cut has bent too far south.

waypoints.name: Lunch in the wood
waypoints.story: They stop for lunch and a cheerful drinking song, until a long wailing cry from a Rider sends them on again.

waypoints.name: Edge of the wood
waypoints.story: The wood ends, the land grows tame and the sun comes out.

waypoints.name: The Marish fields
waypoints.story: Now there are meadows, hedges, gates and drainage dikes: the well-farmed lowlands of the Marish.

waypoints.name: Marish lowlands
waypoints.story: They pick their way east between hedges and ditches over flat, damp farmland.

waypoints.name: Maggot's fields
waypoints.story: Frodo recognises the fields of Farmer Maggot, whose dogs gave him a fright as a boy when he was caught taking mushrooms.

waypoints.name: The turnip field gate
waypoints.story: Past a turnip field, a stout gate opens onto a rutted lane between hedges.

waypoints.name: Farmer Maggot's house
waypoints.story: Farmer Maggot greets them warmly, tells them of a strange rider asking for Baggins, and feeds them well.

waypoints.name: The Causeway
waypoints.story: Maggot's lane meets the Causeway and the farmer drives them on toward the Ferry in his wagon.

waypoints.name: Merry on the Causeway
waypoints.story: Hoofbeats in the fog turn out to be Merry, come out to look for them.

waypoints.name: Bucklebury Ferry
waypoints.story: They pole across the Brandywine on the ferry, and from the far side see a dark shape stooping on the landing they just left.

waypoints.name: Under Buck Hill
waypoints.story: North from the landing with Buck Hill on the left, then up a lane into the country.

waypoints.name: Crickhollow
waypoints.story: At the little house in Crickhollow, Merry, Pippin and Sam reveal that they have known his secret all along and will not let him go alone.

waypoints.name: Tunnel under the Hedge
waypoints.story: At first light they lead their ponies through a tunnel under the High Hay and into the Old Forest.

waypoints.name: The Bonfire Glade
waypoints.story: They come to the Bonfire Glade, where Bucklanders once burned back the trees, and find a path beyond it.

waypoints.name: Watchful trees
waypoints.story: The trees seem to lean in and the path keeps bending away from where they want to go.

waypoints.name: Climbing the forest path
waypoints.story: The path climbs gently through the grey trunks, hot and airless.

waypoints.name: Pippin's shout
waypoints.story: Pippin shouts at the trees to let them through, and the silence afterward is worse.

waypoints.name: The bald knoll
waypoints.story: On top of a bare knoll they rest and eat, and look over the haze to the line of the Withywindle valley.

waypoints.name: Leaving the path
waypoints.story: The path bends southeast; they leave it and try to force their way north.

waypoints.name: The deep folds
waypoints.story: One deep fold after another runs across their way, always turning them east and down.

waypoints.name: The fold to the river
waypoints.story: A fold too deep to climb out of carries them down toward the Withywindle in the late afternoon.

waypoints.name: Withywindle bank path
waypoints.story: Merry finds a path along the river bank, and they follow it east through soft ground.

waypoints.name: Old Man Willow
waypoints.story: Drowsy under a great old willow, Merry and Pippin are swallowed by its cracks until Tom Bombadil comes singing down the path and sets them free.

chapters.title: In the House of Tom Bombadil
chapters.leg: Old Man Willow to Tom's house

waypoints.name: Following Tom
waypoints.story: They trot after Tom up the river in the dusk, his song drifting back to them.

waypoints.name: Tom Bombadil's house
waypoints.story: Goldberry welcomes them at the house under the hill, and they stay a rainy day listening to Tom's tales.

chapters.title: Fog on the Barrow-downs
chapters.leg: Tom's house to the East Road

waypoints.name: Brow of the downs
waypoints.story: Tom's zigzag path takes them up to the brow of the Barrow-downs on a bright morning.

waypoints.name: Green downs
waypoints.story: The ponies climb steep green slopes and run down long limbs of the hills; there are no trees and no water.

waypoints.name: Barrow mounds
waypoints.story: Green mounds crowned with standing stones sit on some of the hilltops like teeth in old gums.

waypoints.name: A dark line to the north
waypoints.story: Far off they glimpse a dark line they take to be the trees along the Road.

waypoints.name: Drifting east
waypoints.story: Without meaning to, they keep turning more east than they intend.

waypoints.name: The standing stone hollow
waypoints.story: They eat and doze in a hollow beside a tall standing stone, and wake to find thick fog all around and the sun sinking.

waypoints.name: The Barrow-wight
waypoints.story: Lost and separated in the fog, Frodo is taken by a Barrow-wight. He calls Tom with the song he was taught, and Tom breaks the barrow open in the morning.

waypoints.name: The northern gap
waypoints.story: With Tom leading, the ponies ride north through a gap in the downs.

waypoints.name: The downs fall away
waypoints.story: The hills grow lower and the fog of yesterday seems a bad dream.

waypoints.name: The old dike
waypoints.story: A dike and hedge mark the long-forgotten border of the North Kingdom.

waypoints.name: Beyond the dike
waypoints.story: They ride on over falling ground in the bright afternoon.

waypoints.name: Trees of the Road
waypoints.story: A line of trees ahead marks the Great East Road at last.

waypoints.name: Back on the East Road
waypoints.story: They reach the Road toward evening and Tom bids them farewell. Unseen, a Ranger watches them pass.

chapters.title: At the Sign of the Prancing Pony

waypoints.name: Bree-hill
waypoints.story: The dark bulk of Bree-hill rises ahead as night falls, with lit windows on its western side.

waypoints.name: The Prancing Pony
waypoints.story: Barliman Butterbur takes them in. In the common room the Ring slips onto Frodo's finger, and a weathered Ranger called Strider asks for a word.

waypoints.name: Bill Ferny's house
waypoints.story: They leave Bree late with a thin pony bought from Bill Ferny, who jeers until Sam throws an apple at him.

waypoints.name: The road east of Bree
waypoints.story: Strider leads them along the Road for a while in plain sight to fool any watchers.

waypoints.name: Into the Chetwood
waypoints.story: They turn off the Road and north into the Chetwood, where no living thing stirs all day.

waypoints.name: Strider's hidden paths
waypoints.story: Strider follows paths no hobbit could find, winding between the trees.

waypoints.name: Skirting Archet
waypoints.story: They pass to the east of Archet, the last village of the Bree-land.

waypoints.name: Camp east of Archet
waypoints.story: First camp out of Bree, under the trees of the Chetwood.

waypoints.name: Quiet woods
waypoints.story: The ground drops slowly eastward; the woods are quiet and peaceful.

waypoints.name: Dappled glades
waypoints.story: Sun falls through the leaves and for a day it is almost easy going.

waypoints.name: Wandering trail
waypoints.story: Strider doubles and turns to leave no clear trail behind them.

waypoints.name: Eastern Chetwood
waypoints.story: Strider sings softly at the evening halt, and the hobbits begin to trust him.

waypoints.name: Eastern Chetwood camp
waypoints.story: They camp near the eastern edge of the wood.

waypoints.name: Out of the Chetwood
waypoints.story: The trees thin out and they come into open country.

waypoints.name: Open lands
waypoints.story: Low rolling land, and the hobbits miss the cover of the trees.

waypoints.name: Damp ground
waypoints.story: The ground grows soft and wet underfoot.

waypoints.name: Midgewater Marshes
waypoints.story: They enter the western edge of the Midgewater Marshes, where every step finds a bog.

waypoints.name: Midges by the thousand
waypoints.story: Midges swarm up from the reeds, and Sam wonders what they live on when they cannot get hobbit.

waypoints.name: First marsh camp
waypoints.story: A miserable damp camp in the western part of the marshes.

waypoints.name: Neekerbreekers
waypoints.story: Some horrible cricket-like insect squeaks all night; Sam names them neekerbreekers.

waypoints.name: Reeds and tussocks
waypoints.story: They hop from tussock to tussock through rushes higher than their heads.

waypoints.name: Treacherous mire
waypoints.story: Pools of mud wait to swallow a careless step, and the pony struggles.

waypoints.name: Pools and sedge
waypoints.story: Still more water and sedge, and the eastern edge never seems closer.

waypoints.name: Lights on Weathertop
waypoints.story: In the eastern marshes they watch flashes of light far off on the hills during the night.

waypoints.name: Drier ground
waypoints.story: The ground begins to firm up and the midges give out.

waypoints.name: Eastern edge of the marshes
waypoints.story: Out of the marshes at last, they see the Weather Hills ahead.

waypoints.name: Rising land
waypoints.story: The land starts to rise, dry and very barren, with only a few birds.

waypoints.name: Barren stretches
waypoints.story: Wide empty stretches of scrub, with nothing to break the wind.

waypoints.name: Weather Hills in view
waypoints.story: The line of the Weather Hills grows clearer with every mile.

waypoints.name: Alder camp
waypoints.story: They camp by a small stream under stunted alders while the moon waxes.

waypoints.name: Morning frost
waypoints.story: A hard frost and a very clear sky; on the hills ahead they can see crumbling ruins.

waypoints.name: The long approach
waypoints.story: Strider sets a steady pace toward the hills.

waypoints.name: Stony slopes
waypoints.story: The ground turns stony and the hobbits' feet ache.

waypoints.name: Old walls on the heights
waypoints.story: Strider speaks of the watchtower that once stood on Weathertop.

waypoints.name: Shadow of the hills
waypoints.story: The hills loom closer in the afternoon light.

waypoints.name: Foot of the Weather Hills
waypoints.story: They camp at the foot of the hills.

waypoints.name: The hidden path
waypoints.story: A cunningly hidden path runs south along the hills, edged with stones where the land is open.

waypoints.name: Gil-galad's song
waypoints.story: Sam recites part of the old poem of Gil-galad, which he learned from Bilbo.

waypoints.name: The stone-edged path
waypoints.story: The path keeps to hollows and folds, made long ago to be unseen.

waypoints.name: The dell under Weathertop
waypoints.story: At midday they reach a dell at the western foot of the hill.

waypoints.name: Summit of Weathertop
waypoints.story: On the summit Strider finds a scratched mark that may be Gandalf's, and they spy dark figures on the Road below.

waypoints.name: Night attack in the dell
waypoints.story: Five Riders come in the dark. Frodo puts on the Ring and is stabbed by the Witch-king's blade before Strider drives them off with fire.

chapters.title: Flight to the Ford
chapters.leg: Weathertop to the Ford of Bruinen

waypoints.name: Frodo on the pony
waypoints.story: Wounded and cold, Frodo rides Bill the pony while the others walk south from the dell.

waypoints.name: Away from the Road
waypoints.story: Strider leads them south and away, through broken country.

waypoints.name: Hiding from the Riders
waypoints.story: Every sound in the brush makes them freeze, but the Riders do not follow yet.

waypoints.name: Crossing the Road again
waypoints.story: They cross the Great East Road quickly and plunge into thickets on its south side.

waypoints.name: Thickets south of the Road
waypoints.story: Thorny thickets and the land sloping south.

waypoints.name: Southward slopes
waypoints.story: Strider keeps them moving under cover of the scrub.

waypoints.name: First thicket camp
waypoints.story: They camp hidden in the thickets, and Strider tends Frodo's wound with athelas.

waypoints.name: Frodo's cold arm
waypoints.story: The cold creeps from Frodo's shoulder into his arm.

waypoints.name: Wild lone-lands
waypoints.story: The Lone-lands stretch empty around them with no sign of house or road.

waypoints.name: Dry gullies
waypoints.story: They pick their way through dry gullies to stay out of sight.

waypoints.name: A wandering course
waypoints.story: Strider bends their course to throw off pursuit.

waypoints.name: Scrub and stone
waypoints.story: Endless scrub, stone and grey sky.

waypoints.name: Second camp from Weathertop
waypoints.story: Another cold camp, with Merry and Sam taking turns at watch.

waypoints.name: A wide shallow valley
waypoints.story: They find a wide shallow valley curving away to the east and follow it.

waypoints.name: Following the valley
waypoints.story: The valley floor gives easier walking for the pony.

waypoints.name: Grey weather
waypoints.story: The sky stays grey and heavy and there is little talk.

waypoints.name: Strider scouting
waypoints.story: Strider ranges ahead and comes back with no news, which is good news.

waypoints.name: Valley bend
waypoints.story: The valley swings around and they follow it.

waypoints.name: Third camp from Weathertop
waypoints.story: They camp in the curving valley, the Riders nowhere seen.

waypoints.name: Valley walls
waypoints.story: Low slopes rise on either hand as they go on down the valley.

waypoints.name: Frodo's shadows
waypoints.story: Frodo sees things grey and faint, as if a shadow lay on his eyes.

waypoints.name: Long valley miles
waypoints.story: The hobbits trudge on in silence, mile after mile.

waypoints.name: Water at last
waypoints.story: A thin stream gives them fresh water.

waypoints.name: Valley evening
waypoints.story: Evening falls early under the clouds.

waypoints.name: Fourth camp from Weathertop
waypoints.story: Another camp in the valley; Frodo hardly sleeps.

waypoints.name: Rising land again
waypoints.story: The land starts to rise ahead of them.

waypoints.name: Huddle of hills
waypoints.story: A huddle of hills appears ahead in the east.

waypoints.name: Strider's worry
waypoints.story: Strider fears the Riders may be watching the bridge ahead.

waypoints.name: Toward the hills
waypoints.story: They climb slowly toward the hills.

waypoints.name: Thin rations
waypoints.story: Food is running low and Sam rations it carefully.

waypoints.name: Fifth camp from Weathertop
waypoints.story: They camp with the hills now close.

waypoints.name: High ground
waypoints.story: From a height they see far ahead to the east.

waypoints.name: A glint of water
waypoints.story: Far off there is a glint of water in the valley ahead.

waypoints.name: Down toward the river
waypoints.story: They work down slopes toward the river lands.

waypoints.name: Near the bridge
waypoints.story: Strider brings them toward the Road where it meets the river.

waypoints.name: Hidden hollow
waypoints.story: They pick a hidden hollow for the night.

waypoints.name: Camp above the Hoarwell
waypoints.story: Their camp is high enough for Merry to see the Hoarwell gleaming far off.

waypoints.name: Back to the Road
waypoints.story: They return to the Great East Road for the crossing.

waypoints.name: The Last Bridge
waypoints.story: On the Last Bridge over the Hoarwell, Strider finds a pale green elf-stone, a sign that friends have passed this way.

waypoints.name: North into the Trollshaws
waypoints.story: They turn north off the Road into steep lands with ruined walls and towers on the hills.

waypoints.name: Trollshaws camp
waypoints.story: The hills shut them in quickly and the going is hard.

waypoints.name: Steep hill paths
waypoints.story: Up and down steep slopes, with no straight way anywhere.

waypoints.name: More climbing
waypoints.story: Another day of climbing and another cold camp.

waypoints.name: Turning wet
waypoints.story: The weather turns wet and the slopes grow slippery.

waypoints.name: Rain in the hills
waypoints.story: Rain all day, and every hollow runs with water.

waypoints.name: Forced north
waypoints.story: The hills grow higher and steeper and force them north out of their way.

waypoints.name: Shelf by the cave
waypoints.story: They camp on a stony shelf by a shallow cave while the rain goes on.

waypoints.name: Rocky ground
waypoints.story: The rain stops; Strider scouts and they scramble southeast over rocks.

waypoints.name: Saddle on the ridge
waypoints.story: They camp in a saddle at the top of a ridge, cold, with a fire under a gnarled pine.

waypoints.name: The easier slope
waypoints.story: Beyond the ridge the slope is easy and the day bright; they see the river in the distance.

waypoints.name: The old trail
waypoints.story: They come upon a trail running through the woods.

waypoints.name: The troll-hole
waypoints.story: They find the trolls' cave from Bilbo's adventure, with its door ajar.

waypoints.name: The Stone Trolls
waypoints.story: In a clearing stand the three trolls, turned to stone long ago. Sam makes up a song about a troll and a boot.

waypoints.name: Through the woods
waypoints.story: A level path through the woods in the afternoon.

waypoints.name: Toward the Road
waypoints.story: The path heads back down toward the Road.

waypoints.name: Return to the Road
waypoints.story: They come back to the Road in the evening.

waypoints.name: Searching for a camp
waypoints.story: They walk on as the light fails, looking for a place to rest.

waypoints.name: Glorfindel
waypoints.story: Bells and hoofbeats on the Road bring Glorfindel of Rivendell, sent to find them.

waypoints.name: Frodo on Asfaloth
waypoints.story: Glorfindel sets Frodo on his white horse and they march on through the night.

waypoints.name: Night march
waypoints.story: The hobbits stumble on, half asleep, while Glorfindel keeps watch behind.

waypoints.name: Elf-light
waypoints.story: Glorfindel's presence seems to lighten the dark around them.

waypoints.name: Toward dawn
waypoints.story: The eastern sky pales at last.

waypoints.name: Dawn camp by the Road
waypoints.story: They rest beside the Road for less than five hours.

waypoints.name: On the Road again
waypoints.story: Back on the Road with tired feet.

waypoints.name: Hurrying east
waypoints.story: Glorfindel urges them on; the Riders are behind.

waypoints.name: First rest on the Road
waypoints.story: A short halt, then on again.

waypoints.name: Footsore miles
waypoints.story: Merry and Pippin limp along without complaint.

waypoints.name: Second rest on the Road
waypoints.story: Another short halt by the roadside.

waypoints.name: Hills to the north
waypoints.story: The road runs on with hills rising to the north.

waypoints.name: Late afternoon
waypoints.story: The light lengthens and still they march.

waypoints.name: Bend toward the Bruinen
waypoints.story: They camp where the Road bends right to run down toward the river.

waypoints.name: Early start
waypoints.story: Off in the grey morning, hobbling downhill.

waypoints.name: Grassy roadsides
waypoints.story: The road runs on downhill with grass along both edges.

waypoints.name: The red-stone cutting
waypoints.story: The road plunges through a cutting of red stone among tall pines, and Glorfindel cries to Frodo to ride.

waypoints.name: Ford of Bruinen
waypoints.story: Asfaloth outruns the Nine across the flat. Frodo reaches the far bank and turns to defy the Riders. The river rises in a flood of white horses and sweeps them away, and Frodo falls.

waypoints.name: Elves bear Frodo
waypoints.story: Glorfindel and the Elves lift Frodo and carry him on.

waypoints.name: The hidden valley path
waypoints.story: The others follow the path down into the hidden valley.

waypoints.name: Rivendell
waypoints.story: Frodo wakes in Elrond's house, healed, with Gandalf at his bedside.

waypoints.name: Setting out at dusk
waypoints.story: The Fellowship of nine leaves Rivendell at dusk on a cold December evening.

waypoints.name: Down the valley road
waypoints.story: They walk the valley road in the dark, Sam leading Bill the pony.

waypoints.name: South from the Ford
waypoints.story: At the Ford of Bruinen they turn south onto narrow paths among folded lands.

waypoints.name: Folded lands
waypoints.story: Narrow paths wind up and down through tumbled country.

waypoints.name: Marching by night
waypoints.story: They march by night to avoid the eyes of the Enemy.

waypoints.name: Aragorn's way
waypoints.story: Aragorn knows these lands and picks the path without a pause.

waypoints.name: Grey before dawn
waypoints.story: The sky greys and they look for shelter.

waypoints.name: First day camp
waypoints.story: They walk until dawn and sleep through the day.

waypoints.name: Empty country
waypoints.story: Empty country, rough and barren, under a cold sky.

waypoints.name: Stony ridges
waypoints.story: Low stony ridges to cross one after another.

waypoints.name: Gimli's silence
waypoints.story: Gimli walks with his eyes on the mountains, silent.

waypoints.name: East wind
waypoints.story: A bitter wind blows from the east all night.

waypoints.name: Camp in a hollow
waypoints.story: They camp in a hollow out of the wind.

waypoints.name: Cold and windy
waypoints.story: Cold and windy, and the hobbits pull their cloaks tight.

waypoints.name: Pippin's grumbling
waypoints.story: Pippin grumbles about walking all night and sleeping all day.

waypoints.name: Starlit hills
waypoints.story: Hills stand black against the stars.

waypoints.name: Thin frost
waypoints.story: Frost silvers the grass toward morning.

waypoints.name: Third day camp
waypoints.story: Another cold camp as dawn comes.

waypoints.name: Few paths
waypoints.story: Paths are few and winding.

waypoints.name: Bill's patience
waypoints.story: Bill the pony plods on, cheerful under his load.

waypoints.name: Lonely land
waypoints.story: Not a house nor a fire anywhere.

waypoints.name: Mountains to the east
waypoints.story: The Misty Mountains march along the eastern sky.

waypoints.name: Fourth day camp
waypoints.story: They lie up for the day among rocks.

waypoints.name: Winding ways
waypoints.story: The way twists through rough country.

waypoints.name: Legolas sings
waypoints.story: Legolas sings softly of the stars as they walk.

waypoints.name: Hidden hollows
waypoints.story: They keep to hollows where they can.

waypoints.name: Thorny thickets
waypoints.story: Bushes of thorn grow thicker as they go.

waypoints.name: Thornbush camp
waypoints.story: They camp in a thicket of thorn bushes.

waypoints.name: Toward the cliff
waypoints.story: Strange broken country ahead in the dark.

waypoints.name: The cliff-top path
waypoints.story: The path comes to a steep drop, and they walk along the cliff top for a while.

waypoints.name: Away from the edge
waypoints.story: They leave the cliff edge and turn south again.

waypoints.name: Yule night
waypoints.story: It is Yule, and they spend it walking.

waypoints.name: Yule camp
waypoints.story: They sleep through the first day of Yule.

waypoints.name: Barren slopes
waypoints.story: Barren slopes, and the wind never stops.

waypoints.name: Long night
waypoints.story: A long night's march under clouds.

waypoints.name: Sam's thoughts of home
waypoints.story: Sam thinks of the Green Dragon and the warm fires of Hobbiton.

waypoints.name: Cold feet
waypoints.story: The hobbits' feet are cold and sore.

waypoints.name: Second Yule camp
waypoints.story: They lie up through the second day of Yule.

waypoints.name: Grey country
waypoints.story: The country stays grey and featureless.

waypoints.name: Boromir's horn
waypoints.story: Boromir carries his great horn, silent now, at his belt.

waypoints.name: New Year's night
waypoints.story: The year turns while they walk.

waypoints.name: Darkness before dawn
waypoints.story: They walk on through the darkest hours.

waypoints.name: New Year camp
waypoints.story: They camp through the first day of January.

waypoints.name: Swamp to the west
waypoints.story: Off to the west the path passes a swamp.

waypoints.name: Cold, grey and windy
waypoints.story: Still cold, grey and windy.

waypoints.name: Steady miles
waypoints.story: Steady miles under Aragorn's lead.

waypoints.name: Wind-bent grass
waypoints.story: Long grass bends flat in the wind.

waypoints.name: Tenth day camp
waypoints.story: Another day spent hidden from the sky.

waypoints.name: Dull skies
waypoints.story: Dull skies and a dull road.

waypoints.name: Hills in the dark
waypoints.story: Shapes of hills loom out of the night.

waypoints.name: Hard ground
waypoints.story: Frozen ground rings under their boots.

waypoints.name: Chill before morning
waypoints.story: The chill deepens before morning.

waypoints.name: Eleventh day camp
waypoints.story: They make camp at dawn.

waypoints.name: Rough going
waypoints.story: Rough going over stones and heather.

waypoints.name: Moonless night
waypoints.story: No moon, and they walk by starlight.

waypoints.name: Aragorn watchful
waypoints.story: Aragorn stops often to listen.

waypoints.name: Weary legs
waypoints.story: Weary legs, and still they go on.

waypoints.name: Twelfth day camp
waypoints.story: They sleep through another grey day.

waypoints.name: Endless south
waypoints.story: The road south seems endless.

waypoints.name: Silent company
waypoints.story: Few words pass between them now.

waypoints.name: Hollows and ridges
waypoints.story: Hollow and ridge, ridge and hollow.

waypoints.name: Night wind
waypoints.story: The night wind sighs over the land.

waypoints.name: Thirteenth day camp
waypoints.story: They camp in the lee of a hill.

waypoints.name: Cold miles
waypoints.story: Cold miles go by in the dark.

waypoints.name: Mountains closer
waypoints.story: The mountains are a little closer each night.

waypoints.name: Heather slopes
waypoints.story: They cross wide slopes of brown heather.

waypoints.name: Faint dawn
waypoints.story: A faint dawn comes up grey.

waypoints.name: Fourteenth day camp
waypoints.story: Another day hidden and resting.

waypoints.name: Last cold night
waypoints.story: The last of the cold weather follows them.

waypoints.name: Wide moors
waypoints.story: Wide moors under a heavy sky.

waypoints.name: Gandalf's pace
waypoints.story: Gandalf walks on, never seeming to tire.

waypoints.name: End of the grey
waypoints.story: Toward morning the clouds begin to break.

waypoints.name: Fifteenth day camp
waypoints.story: They camp as the weather begins to change.

waypoints.name: Mountains of Moria
waypoints.story: The air is warmer and the sky clear, and far ahead stand the three peaks of Moria. The land is eerily quiet.

waypoints.name: Into Hollin
waypoints.story: They enter the old country of Eregion, once home to Elves.

waypoints.name: Silent land
waypoints.story: No birds sing; even Legolas finds the silence strange.

waypoints.name: Holly trees ahead
waypoints.story: Great holly trees mark the ridge ahead.

waypoints.name: Hollin Ridge
waypoints.story: They camp among the hollies on Hollin Ridge until flocks of crebain fly over spying, and they leave at dusk.

waypoints.name: The stone-lined path
waypoints.story: They soon strike a good path, lined with stones, running southeast toward the pass under a full moon.

waypoints.name: Ruins of Eregion
waypoints.story: Broken stones of old Elvish work lie in the grass.

waypoints.name: Full moon
waypoints.story: The full moon lights their way but makes them feel exposed.

waypoints.name: Southeast toward the pass
waypoints.story: The path holds its course toward the mountains.

waypoints.name: Fading stars
waypoints.story: The stars fade toward dawn.

waypoints.name: Shadow over the stars
waypoints.story: Just before dawn Frodo and Gandalf feel something pass across the stars.

waypoints.name: Ninth of January camp
waypoints.story: They camp through a sunny but colder day.

waypoints.name: Climbing road
waypoints.story: The road begins to climb as it winds into the hills.

waypoints.name: Into the foothills
waypoints.story: Foothills close about them as the road goes up.

waypoints.name: Steeper slopes
waypoints.story: The slopes steepen and the air grows thin and cold.

waypoints.name: Caradhras looms
waypoints.story: The red peak of Caradhras towers over them.

waypoints.name: Mountain shadow
waypoints.story: They walk in the shadow of the mountains.

waypoints.name: Foothill camp
waypoints.story: They camp in the foothills through the day.

waypoints.name: Up and up
waypoints.story: The road climbs on into the hills.

waypoints.name: Mountain wind
waypoints.story: A cold wind pours down from the heights.

waypoints.name: Higher still
waypoints.story: The road climbs still higher toward the Redhorn.

waypoints.name: Gandalf and Aragorn debate
waypoints.story: Gandalf and Aragorn argue over the way; Aragorn fears the pass less than the other road.

waypoints.name: Black clouds
waypoints.story: The wind swings northwest and black clouds gather.

waypoints.name: Feet of the Redhorn
waypoints.story: They camp almost at the feet of the Redhorn and each carries a faggot of wood against snow.

waypoints.name: Smooth path upward
waypoints.story: The path is fairly smooth at first and they make good time.

waypoints.name: Fallen stones
waypoints.story: The path grows steep and strewn with fallen stones.

waypoints.name: The snowy shelf
waypoints.story: Cliff on the left, drop on the right; it begins to snow as they reach a shelf at the top of the slope.

waypoints.name: Thickening snow
waypoints.story: The snow falls more thickly and the wind rises.

waypoints.name: A brief halt
waypoints.story: They stop while the wind slackens, then struggle on.

waypoints.name: Redhorn Pass
waypoints.story: The storm overwhelms them. They huddle against the cliff and Gandalf kindles fire with his staff to keep them alive till dawn.

waypoints.name: The great drift
waypoints.story: Aragorn and Boromir plough a path through a great drift while Legolas runs lightly over the snow.

waypoints.name: Shallower snow
waypoints.story: The snow grows steadily shallower as they go down.

waypoints.name: Clear of the snow
waypoints.story: They are back on the shelf of stone and out of the snow by midmorning. Caradhras has defeated them.

chapters.title: A Journey in the Dark
chapters.leg: Caradhras to the Chamber of Mazarbul

waypoints.name: Turning west
waypoints.story: They turn west from the pass road as the crebain return.

waypoints.name: Weary retreat
waypoints.story: A weary march down from the mountain.

waypoints.name: Western foothills
waypoints.story: They trudge along the western foothills.

waypoints.name: Gandalf's choice
waypoints.story: Gandalf speaks of the dark road under the mountains.

waypoints.name: Round the Silvertine
waypoints.story: They bend southwest around the foothills of the Silvertine.

waypoints.name: Grey evening
waypoints.story: Evening falls grey and cold.

waypoints.name: Wolf-howls
waypoints.story: Far off they hear the howling of wolves.

waypoints.name: Ring of stones
waypoints.story: On a hilltop within a ring of stones they hold off the Wargs through the night, Gandalf blazing like fire.

waypoints.name: No bodies at dawn
waypoints.story: At dawn there are no bodies, only arrows on the ground.

waypoints.name: Red stone country
waypoints.story: They cross a barren country of red stones heading south-southeast.

waypoints.name: Searching for the stream
waypoints.story: Gandalf seeks the old road beside the stream.

waypoints.name: The Sirannon
waypoints.story: They reach the Gate-stream, almost dry, and follow it east.

waypoints.name: The deep trough
waypoints.story: The path runs in a deep winding trough.

waypoints.name: A hasty meal
waypoints.story: They eat quickly and go on.

waypoints.name: Old road
waypoints.story: Gandalf picks out traces of the old road under the stones.

waypoints.name: Stair Falls
waypoints.story: At the dry falls of the Sirannon, Frodo, Gimli and Gandalf climb the stairs to the valley above.

waypoints.name: The dark lake
waypoints.story: A curving road leads to a valley mostly filled with a dark, still lake.

waypoints.name: Wading the creek
waypoints.story: They wade an evil-smelling stream at the north end of the lake.

waypoints.name: Doors of Durin
waypoints.story: Gandalf reads the riddle on the doors, Sam sends Bill away, and the Watcher in the Water seizes Frodo as they flee inside.

waypoints.name: Gollum's footsteps
waypoints.story: Inside Moria, Frodo begins to hear soft footsteps pattering behind them.

waypoints.name: Choice of paths
waypoints.story: Gandalf halts to choose between ways in the dark.

waypoints.name: Dark passages
waypoints.story: Passage after passage in the light of Gandalf's staff.

waypoints.name: Narrow fissure
waypoints.story: They leap a narrow fissure in the floor.

waypoints.name: The wide chasm
waypoints.story: A wider chasm, seven feet across; Sam jumps it with his pack.

waypoints.name: Ancient halls
waypoints.story: Great halls and stairways open and close around them.

waypoints.name: Echoing dark
waypoints.story: Their footsteps echo in the endless dark.

waypoints.name: The Guardroom
waypoints.story: They camp in a guardroom; Pippin drops a stone down a well and a hammering answers from the deep.

waypoints.name: Right-hand passage
waypoints.story: In the morning they take the right-hand passage.

waypoints.name: Mounting curves
waypoints.story: The road climbs in great curves with no side ways.

waypoints.name: Smooth road
waypoints.story: A smooth road climbs on through the dark.

waypoints.name: Midday halt
waypoints.story: A rest and a meal in the darkness.

waypoints.name: Dwarf-work
waypoints.story: Gimli marvels at the carving of the walls.

waypoints.name: Still climbing
waypoints.story: Still the road goes up.

waypoints.name: Moria-silver
waypoints.story: Gandalf tells of mithril, the wealth and bane of Moria.

waypoints.name: Twenty-first Hall
waypoints.story: They sleep in a great hall of the North End. In the morning grey light falls from a high window.

waypoints.name: Chamber of Mazarbul
waypoints.story: They find Balin's tomb and the last pages of a dwarf book. Drums sound in the deep; orcs and a cave-troll attack.

waypoints.name: Seven flights down
waypoints.story: They escape by the east door and flee down seven flights of stairs.

waypoints.name: Bridge of Khazad-dum
waypoints.story: On the narrow bridge Gandalf turns to face the Balrog. The bridge breaks and both fall into the abyss.

waypoints.name: The Dimrill Gate
waypoints.story: The company runs up the last stairs and out through the Great Gates into the light.

waypoints.name: Below the Dimrill Gate
waypoints.story: Outside the gate they stop and give way to grief.

waypoints.name: Mirrormere
waypoints.story: Gimli leads Frodo and Sam to Durin's Stone and the still Mirrormere, where the crown of stars glints in the water.

waypoints.name: Spring of the Silverlode
waypoints.story: They pause at the icy spring where the Silverlode begins.

waypoints.name: Down the Dimrill road
waypoints.story: The road runs south down the dale.

waypoints.name: The dell of rest
waypoints.story: Frodo and Sam lag behind, so Aragorn and Boromir carry them to a dell where Aragorn tends their wounds and Frodo's mithril coat is revealed.

waypoints.name: Dusk on the road
waypoints.story: Dusk falls as they hurry on.

waypoints.name: Glowing eyes
waypoints.story: Frodo hears the soft feet again and sees two pale eyes behind.

waypoints.name: Edge of the Golden Wood
waypoints.story: They pass under the eaves of Lothlorien.

waypoints.name: The Nimrodel
waypoints.story: They wade the Nimrodel while Legolas sings its tale. Haldir's Elves take them up into a flet for the night as orcs pass below.

waypoints.name: Beside the Silverlode
waypoints.story: In the morning they follow a path south beside the Silverlode.

waypoints.name: Rope bridge
waypoints.story: They cross the Silverlode on ropes and are blindfolded, Gimli last of all after much argument.

waypoints.name: The Naith of Lorien
waypoints.story: Blindfolded, they walk the smooth paths of the Naith between the rivers.

waypoints.name: Scent of the trees
waypoints.story: Frodo smells the trees and grass and hears the leaves above.

waypoints.name: Haldir's guidance
waypoints.story: Haldir leads them by hidden paths.

waypoints.name: Grass underfoot
waypoints.story: Soft grass replaces stone under their feet.

waypoints.name: Elven voices
waypoints.story: Voices sing in the trees as they pass.

waypoints.name: Deep in the Naith
waypoints.story: On they walk, trusting their guides.

waypoints.name: The open glade
waypoints.story: They feel open sky above as they cross a glade.

waypoints.name: Afternoon path
waypoints.story: The path runs on through the trees.

waypoints.name: Evening falls
waypoints.story: The light fades and they halt.

waypoints.name: Sleeping on the ground
waypoints.story: They sleep on the ground, still blindfolded.

waypoints.name: Second blindfolded day
waypoints.story: Another day of walking blind.

waypoints.name: Wind in the mallorns
waypoints.story: Wind stirs the golden leaves high above.

waypoints.name: News from the borders
waypoints.story: Elves bring word that the orcs were destroyed.

waypoints.name: Smooth paths
waypoints.story: The paths grow wider and smoother.

waypoints.name: Near the heart
waypoints.story: They draw near the heart of the wood.

waypoints.name: Cerin Amroth
waypoints.story: Blindfolds removed, they climb the green mound of Cerin Amroth, bright with golden elanor, and Aragorn stands lost in memory.

waypoints.name: Down from the hill
waypoints.story: They walk on through the golden afternoon.

waypoints.name: The city road
waypoints.story: A wide road leads on toward the city of the trees.

waypoints.name: Lanterns lit
waypoints.story: Elves light lanterns as evening falls.

waypoints.name: Walls of Caras Galadhon
waypoints.story: They reach the north side of a great green wall with a deep fosse, and tall trees rising within.

waypoints.name: The white bridge
waypoints.story: They walk around the walls to the white bridge and the great gates on the south side.

waypoints.name: Caras Galadhon
waypoints.story: They climb to meet Celeborn and Galadriel, and stay a month. Frodo and Sam look into Galadriel's Mirror.

waypoints.name: South through the woods
waypoints.story: Haldir leads them south and east through rolling woods.

waypoints.name: Falling land
waypoints.story: The land falls away toward the rivers.

waypoints.name: Near the Anduin
waypoints.story: They come near the meeting of the waters.

waypoints.name: The Silverlode lawn
waypoints.story: On a lawn by the river the Lady gives her gifts: a phial of starlight for Frodo, a box of earth for Sam, three golden hairs for Gimli.

waypoints.name: Meeting of the Silverlode and Anduin
waypoints.story: The boats slip out of the Silverlode onto the Great River, and soon the high banks hide the light of Lorien.

waypoints.name: First night on the river
waypoints.story: They draw the boats up under the west bank for the night, with the grey woods of Lorien already far behind.

waypoints.name: A long day on the water
waypoints.story: Day after day of paddling on cold grey water; the trees thin and the banks grow bare and lonely.

waypoints.name: Edge of the Brown Lands
waypoints.story: Trees give way to withered downs on the east bank, the edge of the Brown Lands.

waypoints.name: Field of Celebrant
waypoints.story: They camp on the flats north of the Field of Celebrant.

waypoints.name: North Undeep
waypoints.story: Stony beaches and gravel shoals at the North Undeep force them to go carefully.

waypoints.name: Mouth of the Limlight
waypoints.story: The Limlight flows in from the west.

waypoints.name: The Wold
waypoints.story: Along the Wold of Rohan Sam spots a log with pale eyes paddling after them, and that night Gollum creeps close to the camp during Frodo's watch.

waypoints.name: Travelling by night
waypoints.story: Wary of eyes on the east shore, they now hide under the bank by day and let the river carry them through the dark.

waypoints.name: South Undeep
waypoints.story: In the dark they pass the western loop of the South Undeep.

waypoints.name: Gollum following on the log
waypoints.story: Night after night the log drifts behind them, and Aragorn tells Frodo he has known since Moria that Gollum is on their trail.

waypoints.name: Lowlands before the Emyn Muil
waypoints.story: The flat lands on either bank start to rise and the river quickens as the first rough hills of the Emyn Muil come into view.

waypoints.name: The Emyn Muil
waypoints.story: Low cliffs and grey chimneys rise as the river enters the higher Emyn Muil.

waypoints.name: Sarn Gebir
waypoints.story: At midnight the current drags them toward the rapids of Sarn Gebir. Orcs attack from the east bank and Legolas shoots down a winged shadow.

waypoints.name: Portage path
waypoints.story: In the fog they carry boats and packs down an old portage path to the foot of the rapids.

waypoints.name: The Argonath
waypoints.story: The boats are swept between the two great stone kings, the Pillars of the Kings.

waypoints.name: Nen Hithoel
waypoints.story: They pass out of the chasm onto the wide lake of Nen Hithoel.

waypoints.name: Parth Galen
waypoints.story: They land on the green lawn of Parth Galen below Amon Hen, with the roar of Rauros in their ears.

chapters.title: The Breaking of the Fellowship
chapters.leg: Parth Galen to the Emyn Muil

waypoints.name: Across Nen Hithoel
waypoints.story: Frodo slips away in a boat after Boromir's attempt on the Ring. Sam splashes after him and is hauled in, and they paddle across the lake toward the eastern shore.

waypoints.name: Shore under Amon Lhaw
waypoints.story: They land on the eastern shore under Amon Lhaw and hide the boat.

waypoints.name: Into the eastern Emyn Muil
waypoints.story: Together, Frodo and Sam head southeast into the twisted knot of hills.

chapters.title: The Taming of Smeagol
chapters.leg: The Emyn Muil to the gully

waypoints.name: Cliff above the Wetwang
waypoints.story: They reach a sheer cliff overlooking the marshes of the Wetwang.

waypoints.name: Turning north
waypoints.story: No way down; they turn north along the cliff.

waypoints.name: Round a ravine
waypoints.story: They wind around a ravine.

waypoints.name: Down the inner hills
waypoints.story: They climb down the steep east face of the inner hills.

waypoints.name: Boulder camp
waypoints.story: At dusk they hide behind boulders near the cliff and see the glint of Gollum's eyes behind them.

waypoints.name: The gully
waypoints.story: They climb into a gully and out, forced more to the north.

waypoints.name: Northward detour
waypoints.story: Ravines turn them north again and again.

waypoints.name: Midday by the cliff
waypoints.story: Keeping close to the cliff, they stop to eat.

waypoints.name: Grey rock
waypoints.story: Grey rock and grey sky; nothing grows.

waypoints.name: Cliff curves east
waypoints.story: The cliff bends more to the east.

waypoints.name: Another ravine
waypoints.story: Another ravine, and the cliff is still too high to descend.

waypoints.name: Rough scramble
waypoints.story: They scramble through jagged rocks.

waypoints.name: Ravine camp
waypoints.story: They climb into one more ravine and camp at dusk.

waypoints.name: Cliff bends north
waypoints.story: The cliff curves sharply north while the Wetwang falls away south.

waypoints.name: Third-day ravine
waypoints.story: Yet another ravine to cross.

waypoints.name: Forced back
waypoints.story: Rough ground forces them back from the edge.

waypoints.name: Barren hills
waypoints.story: Bare rugged hills without even grass; they stop to eat.

waypoints.name: First sight of the Dead Marshes
waypoints.story: From a ravine they see the southern edge of the Dead Marshes below the tumbled lands.

waypoints.name: Lost in a ravine
waypoints.story: They follow a ravine down and lose their bearings.

waypoints.name: Going in circles
waypoints.story: They realise they are going in circles.

waypoints.name: Smell of the marshes
waypoints.story: A foul smell drifts up from the marshes below.

waypoints.name: Stony hollow camp
waypoints.story: They camp in a cold stony hollow ringed by jagged pinnacles.

waypoints.name: Close to the cliff
waypoints.story: They keep close to the cliff, hoping for a way down.

waypoints.name: Listening for Gollum
waypoints.story: Forced far back, they stop to listen for the creature following them.

waypoints.name: Scored rock
waypoints.story: Scored and weathered rock forces them away from the edge.

waypoints.name: Lower cliffs
waypoints.story: Unknown to them, the cliff is growing lower.

waypoints.name: The deep cleft
waypoints.story: They scramble into a deep cleft and out again.

waypoints.name: Weary hobbits
waypoints.story: Hungry and tired, they go on.

waypoints.name: A brief meal
waypoints.story: A short halt to eat.

waypoints.name: Another cleft
waypoints.story: Another cleft to cross.

waypoints.name: Scrambling on
waypoints.story: Still scrambling along back from the ridge.

waypoints.name: Back from the edge
waypoints.story: They keep back from the edge where the going is a little easier.

waypoints.name: Approaching storm
waypoints.story: Clouds pile up in the west.

waypoints.name: The rope descent
waypoints.story: In a storm Frodo slips down the cliff; Sam remembers the elven rope from Lorien, hauls him up, and they use it to climb down. Afterward the rope comes loose by itself.

waypoints.name: Wet boulders
waypoints.story: At the foot of the cliff they pick their way east through wet boulders.

waypoints.name: The great fissure
waypoints.story: A great fissure with a stream bars their way.

waypoints.name: Gollum caught
waypoints.story: Gollum creeps down the cliff after them and they catch him. He swears by the Precious to serve the master of the Ring.

waypoints.name: Gollum leads north
waypoints.story: In the small hours Gollum leads them back north.

waypoints.name: Down into the rift
waypoints.story: They climb down into a rift and follow a stony stream south while Gollum mutters a riddle about fish.

waypoints.name: Following the stream
waypoints.story: The rift runs on south beside the stream.

waypoints.name: Gully turns east
waypoints.story: The gully turns east and grows wide and shallow.

waypoints.name: Shelf of stone camp
waypoints.story: They camp at dawn on a flat shelf of stone; both mean to watch, and both sleep.

chapters.title: The Passage of the Marshes
chapters.leg: The gully to the slag-hills of the Morannon

waypoints.name: Shallowing gully
waypoints.story: Setting out at dark, they follow the gully as it grows shallower.

waypoints.name: Muddier ground
waypoints.story: The gully floor becomes less rocky.

waypoints.name: Northern creek
waypoints.story: A creek joins from the north and they stop to eat.

waypoints.name: Mossy banks
waypoints.story: The sides dwindle to mere banks.

waypoints.name: Winding stream
waypoints.story: The stream begins to wind and the sky clouds over.

waypoints.name: Mossy mounds
waypoints.story: The banks shrink to mossy mounds.

waypoints.name: Edge of the Dead Marshes
waypoints.story: The stream slips over a ledge into the bog; mists rise ahead, and far off the mountains of Mordor catch the dawn.

waypoints.name: Gollum's path
waypoints.story: Gollum's path winds through the mist between pools and soft mires. No birds call.

waypoints.name: Through the mists
waypoints.story: They follow Gollum through the grey fog.

waypoints.name: Reed-thicket camp
waypoints.story: As the mists lift they hide for the day in a reed thicket.

waypoints.name: Heart of the Dead Marshes
waypoints.story: They enter the heart of the marshes in the late afternoon.

waypoints.name: The stagnant mere
waypoints.story: They go round a wide stagnant mere where the air is black and heavy.

waypoints.name: Candles of corpses
waypoints.story: Pale lights flicker over the water like candles.

waypoints.name: Faces in the water
waypoints.story: Sam stumbles and sees dead faces deep in the pools, the fallen of an ancient battle.

waypoints.name: Foundering in the mire
waypoints.story: They almost crawl through the treacherous mire.

waypoints.name: Firmer ground
waypoints.story: Before dawn they reach firmer ground in a lane between high reeds.

waypoints.name: Wings over the marsh
waypoints.story: A Nazgul passes overhead and the marsh lights go out; Gollum cowers and will not move.

waypoints.name: The black stone
waypoints.story: At the end of the marshes they hide under a black stone through a grey day.

waypoints.name: Dry peat flats
waypoints.story: They cross dry peat and cracked mud flats; the Ring grows heavier.

waypoints.name: Sloping east
waypoints.story: The land slopes slowly up to the east.

waypoints.name: Long shallow slope
waypoints.story: They climb a long shallow slope.

waypoints.name: Parched air
waypoints.story: The air is bitter and dry.

waypoints.name: Gully curving away
waypoints.story: A gully curves away north and west back to the marshes.

waypoints.name: Wasteland
waypoints.story: Nothing but waste and stone ahead.

waypoints.name: Second day hide
waypoints.story: They hide again through the day.

waypoints.name: The Noman-lands
waypoints.story: The land rises onto the arid moors of the Noman-lands.

waypoints.name: Steep hill face
waypoints.story: They go down a steeper hill face.

waypoints.name: Dead moors
waypoints.story: Dead grass and stones under a grey sky.

waypoints.name: Climbing slope
waypoints.story: Another long slow climb.

waypoints.name: Still on the moors
waypoints.story: Still the moors go on.

waypoints.name: Last of the moors
waypoints.story: The moors fall away toward the Gate.

waypoints.name: The slag pit
waypoints.story: In the Desolation before the Morannon they hide in a pit of oily ooze, and Sam overhears Gollum and Smeagol arguing about a mysterious 'she'.

chapters.title: The Black Gate is Closed
chapters.leg: The slag pit to the Black Gate

waypoints.name: Nazgul overhead
waypoints.story: A Nazgul passes over and they lie flat.

waypoints.name: Creeping on
waypoints.story: They creep on through the dark.

waypoints.name: Midnight wings
waypoints.story: At midnight the winged shadow passes again, high up; Gollum refuses to go until Frodo commands him.

waypoints.name: Toward the Gate
waypoints.story: The towers of the Gate rise ahead.

waypoints.name: Hollow before the Black Gate
waypoints.story: From a hollow they watch armies enter the Black Gate. Gollum offers a secret way south, and Frodo decides to trust him.

chapters.title: Of Herbs and Stewed Rabbit
chapters.leg: The Black Gate to the Ithilien pool

waypoints.name: West of the road
waypoints.story: They walk southwest beside the newly repaired road between mountains and moors.

waypoints.name: Trench-like valley
waypoints.story: The road runs in a trench along the foot of the mountains.

waypoints.name: End of the slag heaps
waypoints.story: The slag heaps end; at midnight the moon rises almost full.

waypoints.name: Moonlit road
waypoints.story: They hurry on under the moon.

waypoints.name: Watching towers
waypoints.story: The Towers of the Teeth keep their watch behind.

waypoints.name: Red light in the Towers
waypoints.story: They can still see a red light in one of the Towers of the Teeth.

waypoints.name: Turning south
waypoints.story: Their way bends slowly south.

waypoints.name: Tower light hidden
waypoints.story: Finally they turn far enough south to hide the light.

waypoints.name: Northern Ithilien
waypoints.story: At dawn they reach Ithilien: heather, pine and fresh, sweet air.

waypoints.name: Onto the road
waypoints.story: Gollum leads them onto the road, straight and level.

waypoints.name: Valley road
waypoints.story: The road runs between the mountains and steep western slopes.

waypoints.name: Woods to the west
waypoints.story: Woods appear to the west and green things grow beside the road.

waypoints.name: Arched bridge
waypoints.story: The road crosses a stream on an arched stone bridge.

waypoints.name: Spring in Ithilien
waypoints.story: Herbs and flowers scent the air.

waypoints.name: Overgrown road
waypoints.story: The road grows more and more overgrown.

waypoints.name: Wild garden
waypoints.story: Ithilien is like a garden run wild.

waypoints.name: Second bridge
waypoints.story: Another stream is bridged.

waypoints.name: The long cutting
waypoints.story: They reach a long straight cutting through a stony ridge.

waypoints.name: The clear pool
waypoints.story: They climb the bank and bathe in a clear pool, and Sam finds an orc fire-ring.

waypoints.name: Stewed rabbit
waypoints.story: Gollum brings coneys and Sam stews them with herbs. Then men of Gondor find them, and Sam glimpses an oliphaunt in the fighting.

waypoints.name: Stream below the pool
waypoints.story: Faramir questions Frodo, then leads them west across the stream.

waypoints.name: Steep slope
waypoints.story: Faramir and Frodo talk as they climb down a steep slope.

waypoints.name: Woodland path
waypoints.story: They thread their way through the woods.

waypoints.name: The narrow gorge
waypoints.story: They come to a small river in a narrow gorge.

waypoints.name: Henneth Annun
waypoints.story: Blindfolded, they are led behind a waterfall to the Window on the West, glowing with sunset. That night Faramir spares Gollum at the forbidden pool.

waypoints.name: Faramir's farewell
waypoints.story: Faramir removes the blindfolds and sends them on with food and advice.

waypoints.name: Upper edge of the slopes
waypoints.story: They follow the upper edge of the steep lands westward.

waypoints.name: Fast stream
waypoints.story: They cross a fast stream and rest to eat.

waypoints.name: Through the trees
waypoints.story: They walk on through woods of Ithilien.

waypoints.name: Quiet afternoon
waypoints.story: Birds sing, but Gollum is uneasy.

waypoints.name: Brief rest
waypoints.story: A short halt under the trees.

waypoints.name: Thinning sun
waypoints.story: The light grows dim.

waypoints.name: Tumbling stream
waypoints.story: They cross a tumbling stream.

waypoints.name: Evening woods
waypoints.story: Evening falls in the woods.

waypoints.name: Ancient tree
waypoints.story: They sleep under a great old tree; Sam is restless.

waypoints.name: First light
waypoints.story: They leave at first light.

waypoints.name: Heavy air
waypoints.story: The air grows heavy and still.

waypoints.name: Thicker trees
waypoints.story: The trees thicken and Gollum urges them on.

waypoints.name: Darkening sky
waypoints.story: Darkness gathers in the east.

waypoints.name: Small stream
waypoints.story: They cross a small stream.

waypoints.name: Ash and oak
waypoints.story: They reach open woods of great ash and oak; Gollum grows afraid.

waypoints.name: Fading light
waypoints.story: Dusk comes early.

waypoints.name: Edge of the Morgul Vale
waypoints.story: At the forest's end they see the vale of Morgul. They rest in an oak until midnight.

waypoints.name: Deep cleft
waypoints.story: They cross a deep cleft in the dark.

waypoints.name: Dark pit
waypoints.story: They skirt a dark pit.

waypoints.name: Down and up
waypoints.story: Down a little, then up a long steep slope.

waypoints.name: Spreading darkness
waypoints.story: Darkness spreads over the sky behind them.

waypoints.name: Thorn hollow
waypoints.story: Halfway down a cliff they crawl into a hollow under a knot of thorns and sleep.

waypoints.name: Broken slope
waypoints.story: There is no dawn. Gollum leads them south across a broken slope.

waypoints.name: The Cross-roads
waypoints.story: In a ring of trees the setting sun lights the fallen head of an old king's statue, crowned with flowers.

chapters.title: The Stairs of Cirith Ungol
chapters.leg: The Cross-roads to the top of the stairs

waypoints.name: The Morgul road
waypoints.story: They follow the straight road east as it climbs.

waypoints.name: The flatiron
waypoints.story: The road curves around a great shoulder of rock.

waypoints.name: Morgulduin ravine
waypoints.story: Frodo looks across the vale and sees Minas Morgul glowing with a sick light.

waypoints.name: Bridge before Minas Morgul
waypoints.story: At the bridge Frodo stumbles toward the city gate before Sam stops him.

waypoints.name: Shelf above Minas Morgul
waypoints.story: From a ledge they watch the Witch-king lead his host out of the city.

waypoints.name: Straight Stair
waypoints.story: They begin the Straight Stair, steep as a ladder.

waypoints.name: Winding path
waypoints.story: A winding path climbs on above the stair.

waypoints.name: Wide shelf
waypoints.story: A wide shelf with a cliff on one side and a chasm on the other.

waypoints.name: Winding Stair
waypoints.story: The Winding Stair zigzags up the cliff.

waypoints.name: Top of the stairs
waypoints.story: At the top they rest between pinnacles, and Sam wonders what tale they have fallen into.

waypoints.name: Torech Ungol
waypoints.story: Gollum leads them into a tunnel too wide to touch both walls.

waypoints.name: First opening
waypoints.story: Sam feels an opening on the right.

waypoints.name: Second opening
waypoints.story: Another opening on the right.

waypoints.name: Opening on the left
waypoints.story: Frodo feels an opening on the left.

waypoints.name: Hanging things
waypoints.story: Their senses go numb as things brush against them in the dark.

waypoints.name: Holding together
waypoints.story: Sam leaves the wall and holds on to Frodo.

waypoints.name: Stench of the lair
waypoints.story: A choking stench fills the tunnel.

waypoints.name: Shelob's pit
waypoints.story: Frodo finds the opening to the main pit.

waypoints.name: Phial of Galadriel
waypoints.story: Gollum is gone. Shelob comes, and Frodo drives her back with the starglass and cuts through the web with Sting.

waypoints.name: Shelob strikes
waypoints.story: Frodo runs ahead and Shelob stings him. Sam fights off Gollum and drives Shelob away.

waypoints.name: Sam takes the Ring
waypoints.story: Believing Frodo dead, Sam takes the Ring and goes on alone.

waypoints.name: The cleft of the pass
waypoints.story: At the cleft Sam hears orcs and learns that Frodo is only stung and alive.

chapters.title: The Tower of Cirith Ungol
chapters.leg: The cleft to the Tower gate

waypoints.name: Tower of Cirith Ungol
waypoints.story: Sam climbs the tower, rescues Frodo, and returns the Ring. Before dawn they pass the silent Watchers at the gate and run.

waypoints.name: The leap from the bridge
waypoints.story: Where the road meets the Morgul road they jump from a bridge into a thorn thicket below.

waypoints.name: Floor of the valley
waypoints.story: They climb down to the bottom of a north-running valley.

waypoints.name: Frodo sheds the mail
waypoints.story: Frodo casts off his heavy orc-mail; Sam wishes for light and water.

waypoints.name: Winged messenger
waypoints.story: A Nazgul streaks overhead toward the Dark Tower with ill news from the west.

waypoints.name: Path by the dry stream
waypoints.story: They cross to a path west of a dry stream bed as the valley rises north.

waypoints.name: Trickling water
waypoints.story: They hear water trickling from a gully and drink at last.

waypoints.name: Northward valley
waypoints.story: The valley climbs slowly north.

waypoints.name: Orc-hold wall
waypoints.story: The track widens beside a rough wall near an orc-hold; midges bite among scrubby trees.

waypoints.name: Bramble ravine
waypoints.story: They hide in brambles. Sam sees a star through the murk and feels hope.

waypoints.name: Ridge above Gorgoroth
waypoints.story: From the ridge they see the plain crawling with enemies and Mount Doom far away.

waypoints.name: Back to the valley floor
waypoints.story: They cannot go north along the ridge and climb back down.

waypoints.name: Orc hold by the path
waypoints.story: An orc hold stands by the path to the west.

waypoints.name: Orc trackers
waypoints.story: Hidden behind a bush they overhear two orcs quarrel and learn Gollum is loose.

waypoints.name: Dark valley
waypoints.story: They creep on in the dark.

waypoints.name: Eastern edge of the valley
waypoints.story: They keep to the eastern edge of the valley.

waypoints.name: Silent miles
waypoints.story: Silent miles in the dark.

waypoints.name: Rocks and thorns
waypoints.story: Thorns tear at their cloaks.

waypoints.name: Endless night
waypoints.story: The night seems to have no end.

waypoints.name: Stagnant pool
waypoints.story: They pass a stagnant pool unseen in the dark.

waypoints.name: Before grey light
waypoints.story: Weariness drags at every step.

waypoints.name: Grey light hide
waypoints.story: In the grey light they hide and sleep.

waypoints.name: Faramir's food
waypoints.story: They eat the last of Faramir's food and start again in the dark.

waypoints.name: First halt
waypoints.story: A brief halt.

waypoints.name: Northward again
waypoints.story: On north along the valley.

waypoints.name: Second halt
waypoints.story: Another short halt.

waypoints.name: Cold stones
waypoints.story: The stones are cold and sharp.

waypoints.name: Third halt
waypoints.story: One more halt before dawn.

waypoints.name: Climbing valley
waypoints.story: The valley climbs toward the inner ridge.

waypoints.name: Broken steps
waypoints.story: The watercourse ends in broken steps of rock.

waypoints.name: Overhanging stone
waypoints.story: They hide under an overhanging stone. Sam finds water and glimpses Gollum.

waypoints.name: Up to the road
waypoints.story: At dusk they climb warily onto the road.

waypoints.name: Durthang road
waypoints.story: The road runs on from the old castle of Durthang.

waypoints.name: Sheer drop
waypoints.story: A sheer drop opens beside the road.

waypoints.name: Side path into Gorgoroth
waypoints.story: A side path runs south toward the main road.

waypoints.name: Orc company
waypoints.story: An orc company takes them for deserters and drives them along in its ranks.

waypoints.name: Forced march
waypoints.story: Frodo staggers under the whip.

waypoints.name: Long slope to the plain
waypoints.story: The road runs down a long slope into the plain.

waypoints.name: Isenmouthe
waypoints.story: They near the Isenmouthe where roads meet.

waypoints.name: Escape into a pit
waypoints.story: In the jostle of companies Sam drags Frodo over the road's edge into a shallow pit.

chapters.title: Mount Doom
chapters.leg: The Isenmouthe to the Crack of Doom

waypoints.name: Pitted plain
waypoints.story: Gorgoroth is pitted with great holes; they crawl from hollow to hollow.

waypoints.name: Back toward the road
waypoints.story: Sam decides they must go back to the road.

waypoints.name: Onto the causeway
waypoints.story: They climb onto the causeway.

waypoints.name: Along the Ash Mountains
waypoints.story: They walk east along the road under the Ash Mountains and see no one.

waypoints.name: Camp off the road
waypoints.story: They sleep just off the road.

waypoints.name: Trudging east
waypoints.story: They trudge on east.

waypoints.name: Weight of the Ring
waypoints.story: The Ring bows Frodo lower every hour.

waypoints.name: Empty cistern
waypoints.story: They find a cistern, but it is dry. They eat and rest.

waypoints.name: Grey road
waypoints.story: The grey road stretches on.

waypoints.name: Midday rest
waypoints.story: A rest by the road.

waypoints.name: Troops at night
waypoints.story: They camp off the road and hear troops pass in the dark.

waypoints.name: Stumbling on
waypoints.story: Frodo stumbles but will not stop.

waypoints.name: Morning rest
waypoints.story: A morning halt.

waypoints.name: Dust and ash
waypoints.story: Dust and ash coat everything.

waypoints.name: Muddy cistern
waypoints.story: A cistern with muddy water: they drink and fill the bottle.

waypoints.name: Thirsty miles
waypoints.story: Every mile makes them thirstier.

waypoints.name: Afternoon rest
waypoints.story: Another rest by the road.

waypoints.name: The night messenger
waypoints.story: They camp and hear a messenger gallop past in the night.

waypoints.name: Silent Frodo
waypoints.story: Frodo has stopped speaking.

waypoints.name: Last road rest
waypoints.story: One more halt on the road.

waypoints.name: Turning to the mountain
waypoints.story: Mount Doom stands due south. They leave the road and turn toward it.

waypoints.name: Open ground
waypoints.story: They cross open ground with no cover.

waypoints.name: Rest on the plain
waypoints.story: A rest on the bare plain.

waypoints.name: Half a bottle
waypoints.story: Only half a bottle of water left.

waypoints.name: The dreadful nightfall
waypoints.story: Frodo sleeps fitfully. At dawn they throw away everything they do not need.

waypoints.name: No concealment
waypoints.story: They make no effort to hide.

waypoints.name: Faster than hoped
waypoints.story: Frodo goes faster than Sam dared hope.

waypoints.name: Rest in the fumes
waypoints.story: Another rest under the reeking sky.

waypoints.name: Last strength
waypoints.story: The effort spends Frodo's last strength; Sam argues with himself and the ground trembles.

waypoints.name: No water
waypoints.story: They go on with no water left.

waypoints.name: Choking fumes
waypoints.story: The fumes grow worse.

waypoints.name: Near the mountain
waypoints.story: A rest near the mountain's foot.

waypoints.name: Foot of Mount Doom
waypoints.story: At the foot of the mountain Sam tries to warm Frodo as he sleeps.

waypoints.name: Up the mountain's base
waypoints.story: Frodo falls and cannot rise. Sam lifts him onto his back and climbs.

waypoints.name: Sauron's Road
waypoints.story: They crawl up to Sauron's road; Frodo sees the Eye and falls.

waypoints.name: Gollum attacks
waypoints.story: Sam carries Frodo again until Gollum springs at them. Sam holds him off while Frodo goes on.

waypoints.name: Door of Sammath Naur
waypoints.story: Frodo enters the door in the mountain's side.

waypoints.name: The Crack of Doom
waypoints.story: At the brink Frodo claims the Ring. Gollum bites it from his finger and falls into the fire, and the Ring is unmade.
